lines.en: : Hello and welcome to everyone who’s decided to tune in for this year’s broadcast of the-
: Super Mega Ultimate Sports-Day Dorm Wars: No Boys Allowed! The Extremely Awesome and Only Kind of Sad Special Event for Bonding and Battling!
: And apologies for the title being so long that it required its own text box! I’m your host and sole teacher of Class A, Imani Imai! And joining me today are Miku Maruyama and Touka Tsukioka.
: Wakana and Good Kid are here as well. Say hi, Wakana.
: I want to fucking die.
: Well said, Wakana. I’m sure that the viewers at home are happy to hear that, despite the many changes we’ve been faced with concerning this year’s contest, some things never change.
: What’s another example of something that never changes, Miku?
: Call of Duty!
: Wrong answer. Touka?
: Um...US Treasury bond yields?
: What you guys were supposed to say is the rivalry between the first and second floors of the dorm!
: Just like Wakana’s outlook on life, the infinite civil war raging between both halves of Class A never changes!
: And while I’m sure this battle won’t put an end to that, it will give both sides one more opportunity to show the other who’s the best!
: But, more importantly than that, it will finally give Touka the opportunity to show us that physical prowess she’s been talking up for a total of four wars now! Anything you’d like to add, Touka?
: Yes! I’m very excited to finally compete in something that will show the viewers at home I can be much more than a sheltered and extremely wealthy young woman.
: And I can think of no better opponent for such a contest than Miku Maruyama herself.
: And Miku! What would you like to say in response to Touka’s opening statement?
: Makoto said she’ll get mad at me if I say anything good about any of our opponents throughout the whole war thing, so I’m gonna go with “no comment!”
: You heard it here first, folks! And, if you haven’t already guessed by the crazy amount of weird set pieces behind me, round three of this year’s Dorm Wars will be the obstacle course!
: But it’s not just any obstacle course. It’s Imani Imai’s super spectacular obstacle course that will put not just these girls’ bodies to the test, but their mental fortitude and creativity as well!
: Before we begin, though, please be advised that we’ve had to remove the “battle to the death” portion of the obstacle course as weapons are not allowed in school.
: If only we were competing in the States.
: This course is divided into six sections and will not be ruled “complete” until one of you escapes the ring and lights the brazier at the finish line.
: Obstacle one is the Sea of Balls’ reclamation of scales!
: Got it!
: The...the what?
: The Sea of Balls’ reclamation of scales! Pay attention! You’ve got enough of a handicap as-is with those water balloons strapped to your chest.
: Can I...ask for clarity as to what exactly that obstacle entails?
: Jump into the ball pit and find a fish!
: What?
: Then bring it over to the Wise Turtle and offer it up in exchange for your vows.
: What?
: After you’ve done that, you’ll move over to obstacle three and get married! But don’t take too long, since it will be time for your vitamins right after that!
: Understood!
: Am I being deceived again? Because this sounds a lot like something Sensei would orchestrate to take advantage of my naiveté and kind heart.
: Just sounds like a normal obstacle course to me. I’m guessin’ we steal the pirate’s treasure after that?
: Exactly! And you’ll then use that treasure to light the brazier after escaping the ring! Any questions?
: Yes. Is it too late to ask for another competition? Because I’m beginning to think that, once again, this competition will not allow me to adequately express my strengths.
: It is too late! But don’t worry! You both have three minutes to formulate your game plans before the obstacle course begins! Just don’t plan out loud or it will make the Wise Turtle mad!
: This joke is carrying on for far too long, Miss Imai!
: I’m glad to see you’re okay now, Sana. You really had us worried when you took that egg to the face.
: It’s fine...I’m just glad Ayane wasn’t using her full power or...I probably would have actually died...
: It’s...unfortunate that we lost, though...I know everyone was counting on us and...and stuff...
: One loss doesn’t mean much. Besides, this is a pretty low-stakes competition. And I’m almost positive the entire purpose behind it is to sort of...cheer everybody up.
: But you’ve actually seemed kind of...content lately. You’re more...cheerful than normal.
: Is...that so?...
: Mhm. And I’m not the only one who seems to think that as well.
: Did something happen?
: Nothing...in particular...
: But I guess...you could say I’m...learning more about...who I really am...or...something like that...
: Well, whatever it is, I’m happy for you. I can tell you’ve worked really hard to get to where you are today.
: You...seem a little different from how you used to be as well...
: Do I?
: Yeah...maybe...you’re feeling a little more confident too now?...
: Futaba?
: AND THEY’RE OFF!!!
: Both contestants dive into the ball pit and are likely fighting off alligators as we speak! But don’t worry! They’re only babies and will likely only do minimal damage to them!
: Imani, please tell me you did not put actual alligators in the-
: Shhhh, it’ll be fine! There are plenty of weapons down there for the girls to protect themselves with! And I’m sure we’ll see one whenever they have to come up for air!
: Why are there so many bananas in this pool of plastic balls?!
: Because I couldn’t throw a bunch of baby alligators in there without giving them something to eat. Come on, Touka. Have some common sense.
: Is that what keeps touching my leg?! An alligator?!
: Finally! It was well-hidden, but-
: What a curious sculpture. And surprisingly accurate as well. I admire the artistry, but I don’t believe that counts as a fish.
: Imani. Why? Why is this an item you possess?
: Yo, porn shop lady can talk me into buying literally anything and there ain’t no way I’m actually gonna use that thing. So hey. Obstacle course.
: STOP PUTTING WEIRD STUFF IN THE BALL PIT! AIN’T YOU EVER GONE TO A PLAY CENTER BEFORE?! THAT’S RULE NUMBER ONE!
: What would you possibly use that for? It’s art, is it not?
: It is an art, sure. Just ask Wakana. She has a demon one. And they must be used carefully or-
: I DON’T WANT TO HEAR IT!
: And they’re back down!
: Can you please refrain from saying such damning things on national television?
: I wouldn’t worry. The longer this drags on, the more viewers we’ll inevitably lose.
: How the heck do I get this thing off of me?!
: Hey! Miku found the blobfish! Which means that any second now, Touka will probably-
: WHY ARE THERE SO MANY BANANAS?! IT’S ALL BANANAS! THERE IS NO WAY THESE BELONG IN HERE!
: It ain’t all bananas! I got a frickin’ blob thing latchin’ on to my finger!
: And I have an alligator getting way too comfortable with my leg! Your problems mean nothing to me!
: This thing is...really frickin’ on there! Medic! Medic!
: I have returned! And without a fruit this time!
: Gah! Hope the Wise Turtle won’t mind gettin’ some fingers as a sacrifice too cause I ain’t stickin’ around to watch banana girl take a lead!
: You touched a horse penis!
: Yeah, but you’ve probably touched a real one!
: Not intentionally!
: Imani, what is this nonsense?
: Awesome, that’s what!
: Fresh out of the ball pit, both contests appear before the Wise Turtle with their gifts! But, in true Japanese fashion, Touka must wait in line as Miku was the first to arrive!
: What do I do now?!
: Convince the Wise Turtle to accept your sacrifice!
: Accept my sacrifice, Wise Turtle!
: The Wise Turtle appears to be just another statue, Miku. It can not possibly accept your-
: Your sacrifice has been accepted, Miku Maruyama. Feel the vows deep within your heart.
: It talks?!?!?!
: Heck yeah it does! Thanks, Wise Turtle! I know now what I must do!
: W...Wise Turtle! Please accept my sacrifice as well!
: Your sacrifice has been accepted, Touma Tsumioma. Feel the-
: AAAAAAHHHHHH!
: Now what?! What do we do next?!

: Now, our contestants must overcome the greatest obstacle of all! Holy matrimony! Complete with the filing of the required paperwork and the depressing knowledge that there is a 50%% chance of divorce!
: Disregarding the facts that same-sex couples cannot even get married in this country and that I am not an ordained minister, Maruyama — your vows, please.
: Touka, even though you’ve accidentally touched a horse wiener at least once, I’ve always loved you and am ready to spend the rest of my life with you.
: I think you’re swell and that we’ll be good at being married and stuff.
: Is that really what the Wise Turtle wanted you to say?
: Yeah. Why? What does he want you to say?
: Tsukioka — your vows. Out with them. This is cutting into my lunch break.
: Touka, hurry the heck up! I ain’t allowed to take my vitamins until you say your vows! Which, if ya think about it, doesn’t make any sense for a friggin’ 1v1 obstacle course!
: Overcoming unfair rules and regulations is an obstacle too! I’ve done nothing wrong!
: Miku Maruyama-
: Munch on deez nuts. I will never marry you. The Wise Turtle has spoken.
: What the heck?! I loved you!
: The wedding is off. Both contestants may advance to vitamin time.
: My life used to be so easy. How did this happen?
: This is the price ya pay for joinin’ us commoners! Now get ready to take your damn vitamins!
: Okay, but...which ones?
: I’m glad you asked, Touka! Because this is actually the most important and unique obstacle of all!
: First, you have to-
: Do you ever miss our other school? Because this place really sucks without Sensei.
: It sucks with him too. But I’m pretty sure that’s just part of what being a teenager is about. Nobody really likes high school from what I understand. At least not while they’re there.
: Yeah but, teaching stuff aside, at least people kind of left me alone at our last school. The more time I spend in this one, the more people wind up getting on my nerves.
: I take it that means the trivia contest didn’t exactly go well?
: I lost. But it wasn’t, like...a decimation or anything. Some of those girls just piss me off. Like that blonde who isn’t a blonde anymore but still acts like a blonde.
: Chika’s not that bad. She actually seems like a really good person to have on your side. And I say that as someone who most definitely does not have her on my side after the whole Rin thing.
: Oh, right. I forgot you had a lesbian phase. Ew.
: Why Rin anyway? She’s loud and weird. You can do way better.
: Timing, maybe?
: She’s the first person I felt like giving a shot to. And she’s not bad either. Things just didn’t work out.
: If anything, you and me are the assholes for not giving as much of a shit as everyone else. Like, what would anyone have to gain from talking to either one of us?
: Chika fiercely defends everyone she loves. Rin’s great at coming up with plans and can get you discounts on coffee whenever you want.
: And, I’m assuming you don’t like Noriko either, but she’s probably the most selfless and generous person I’ve ever met.
: You and me, though? What do we bring to the table? What right do we have to talk down on anyone when we’re just...projects, I guess.
: Not saying you’re wrong about any of that, but...when the hell did you get so depressing?
: Probably when I came here, to be honest. So yeah, I do miss our old school.
: I miss people liking me for no reason other than the fact that I was just cool or well-known around the campus.
: Starting from zero means you have to work for shit. And since neither one of us has actually done that yet, we’re just stuck in the mud now.
: Is that really how we want to be forever? Like, anxiety aside, don’t you think it would be rad to kind of, like...enjoy people other than Uta some day?
: I guess.
: Miku’s not bad. Like, there are definitely parts about her that I don’t like. A lot of them. But we have more in common than I expected with our shitty brain stuff.
: Rin has shitty brain stuff too. She just always holes herself up in her room whenever it kicks in, so it’s harder to see out in the open than a full-blown panic attack would be.
: Yeah, but fucking everyone has depression nowadays. It’s nothing to write home about.
: Have you seen what she does to her arms?
: Not...directly. But self mutilation is very common within our age group and isn’t something to write home about either.
: Io...can you look at me for a second?
: Sure.
: I get that traumatizing shit has happened to you at some point in your life, but you know better than to laugh at what other people have to deal with, don’t you?

: Not really. I’ll laugh at whatever I want to laugh at. And the fact that some people act like their trauma is the end of the world when there are people way worse off than them is kind of hysterical.
: Did you expect me to say something else?
: Yeah...that was a really disgusting thing to say. And I figured that if anyone would know not to do that, it would be the girl who has a handful of pills for breakfast every morning.
: That’s why we’re just acquaintances and not friends. We don’t know each other well.
: Yeah. And that makes me kind of glad.
: Because if we were friends...and you laughed at Rin for her depression while I was dating her, I would have beaten the shit out of you.
: Oh.
: Well, what’s stopping you from doing that now?
: Probably pity.
: Wha- Imani, what the heck are these things?!
: Oh! Ladies and gentlemen, it looks like Miku has made it to the top of the pirate ship! Which means she has encountered the secret stash of blow torches and is ready to escape the ring!
: How the heck am I gonna learn how to use a blow torch on such short notice?!
: I’m sure you’ll be fine, Miku. Such a task will be nothing compared to the utter hell that was the vitamin portion of the obstacle course.
: Yeah, I probably ain’t ever gonna look at VR technology the same after that.
: I thought that part was fine. It was the segment involving the people of Estonia that impacted me the most.
: Time is running out, you two! You better hurry or the pirate ship will explode!
: What?! Ya never said anythin’ about a friggin’ time limit!
: The time limit is the hidden eighth obstacle you must overcome as well! Good luck, girls! Failure to complete the task on time will result in negative ten points!
: This is startin’ to get ridiculous, Imani!
: Starting to get ridiculous?...
: I knew practicin’ my army crawl would come in handy sooner rather than later!
: Speak for yourself! Squeezing under this...net with...breasts this size is proving to be rather difficult!
: Then leave ‘em behind! Ain’t nobody ever gonna see all those redeemin’ qualities of yours with those things in the way!
: You may not understand this due to the fact that you have not started growing yet, but they do not detach! I can not simply “leave them behind!”
: Sounds like a you problem, Touma! See ya at the finish line!
: Not if I have anything to....ahah! I’m through! I can- ngh! No! Now my lower half is...stuck as well!
: Should’a skipped breakfast, loser!
: Any last words before I burn this place to the ground?!
: Yes! Let me do it instead!
: Nice try! But if ya ain’t first, ‘yer last! And Miku Maruyama ain’t about to come in last for anything!
: Wha- I thought you didn’t know how to use that?!
: I guessed and it worked!
: OH GOD, IT WORKED TOO WELL!
: My eyes!
: BURN! BURN! BURN!
: Imani! The extinguisher! Now!
: Huh? Oh! Oh, right! Hold on, girls! I’m-
: Well, that was significantly closer to death than I planned on coming today.
: Yeah...sorry for almost blowin’ the place up. If I’d known that was gonna happen, I would’a told ya to take cover first.
: There’s no reason to apologize, Miku! I actually had a lot of fun even if I lost. And I congratulate you on your victory. You were a worthy adversary.
: I just wish that game would have made any amount of sense at all.
: Yeah, but I can kinda see where Imani’s comin’ from makin’ it as weird as it was. The viewers at home want chaos. Nobody’s gonna keep the channel on if we’re just crawlin’ through mud or whatever.
: I wouldn’t say that, Miku. A big thing I’ve learned from my brief time in the world of commoners is that there are some people out here who are into really strange things.
: You mean like touchin’ horse wieners?
: I retract my congratulations. I no longer like you.
: Well that’s alright with me since I, Miku Maruyama, champion of justice and obstacle courses, have taken round three of the SMUS-DDW: NBA ~ TEAaOKoSSEfBaB!
: What festivities await us next?! Will the first floor add to its lead?! Or will the evil residents of the second floor tie the game again?!
: Find out right after this word from one of our sponsors!
